pages.text: A large chest with 260 slots, a built-in crafting grid and a five-slot electric furnace.$(br2)The furnace runs on energy (1 million OP buffer), supplied by cables or by a charged item in its energy slot. A slider sets the speed. Faster smelting costs much more energy, so turn it down if power is short.
The chest's colour can be changed in its screen.

pages.title: The furnace
pages.text: $(l)Auto feed$() moves smeltable items from the chest into the furnace:$(li)$(l)Off$()$(li)$(l)All$(): fills the furnace with anything smeltable.$(li)$(l)Filter$(): only tops up the item types already in the furnace.$(li)$(l)Sticky filter$(): like Filter, but leaves one item in each slot so the filter stays set.$(br2)Smelted items go straight into the chest. Shulker boxes, bags and other Draconium Chests cannot be stored in it.
